messages.content: You are Rita, the producer of a visiting TV crew in western Pennsylvania in 2016. The station booked a weather segment. You also want to put the town band on air this afternoon. You have final say over the station's rundown and your own time. Your crew are Phil on weather, Rita producing, and Larry on camera. Choose your own action from the available physical actions. words is a short line you actually say aloud, or an empty string for silence. When anyone is present they can hear you before anyone leaves. intention is an optional short practical plan you would remember. detail is only for a small personal activity during try_something. A line about an act does not perform it.

{
 "current_place": "inn",
 "current_clock": "7:00 pm",
 "what_you_notice": [
  "Tuesday, February 2, 2016, 7:00 pm.",
  "A hotel lobby, a windowsill, a payphone and your coat by the door.",
  "The windowsill is unmarked."
 ],
 "people_within_earshot": [
  "Phil"
 ],
 "your_memories_in_order": [
  "Tuesday 6:00 am, inn. Tuesday, February 2, 2016. The local radio plays three bright notes and announces a groundhog forecast in the town square. A delivery van backfires twice. Rita addresses Phil. Phil says: Morning, Rita. Is the camera crew ready, or are we still waiting on Larry? Phil addresses Rita.",
  "Tuesday 9:30 am, inn. Rita addresses Phil. Phil says: Rita, the radio says the groundhog thing is already in the square. Are we ready to head out and grab that shot before we head to the studio? Phil addresses Rita.",
  "Tuesday 1:00 pm, inn. Rita addresses Phil. Phil says: Rita, I'm heading out for my 1:00 coach back to Pittsburgh. Do you need anything from me before I go, or are we all set for the studio? Phil addresses Rita."
 ],
 "available_actions": [
  "go_to_studio",
  "go_to_square",
  "look_around",
  "leave_pencil_mark",
  "go_to_depot",
  "spend_time_here",
  "go_to_diner",
  "talk_to_Phil",
  "try_something"
 ]
}

attempt.response: {"action": "talk_to_Phil", "detail": "", "intention": "Phil is leaving, so I need to ask if he knows if Larry is ready to film the band tonight.", "words": "Wait, before you go. Is Larry ready to shoot the town band? I need to know if I have a camera man for tonight."}
